originality.rationale: The inspected 2026 primary paper records a numerical finite-sample table and explicitly conjectures every-even-sample centered uniqueness. Its exact small-n corollary covers only two populations, and its four-population general theorem has an unspecified eventual sample threshold. No covering finite four-population, two-trial, all-gap theorem surfaced in targeted synonymous literature searches. Remaining prior-art risk is stated rather than denied.
residual_risks: Historical ranked-subset-selection papers might contain a logically equivalent finite four-population theorem under different terminology.
